name: Brew Lab page shell: header, menu, hours, location, styling
purpose: Site v0 has no Brew Lab content. Title, header, menu, hours and location sections are missing.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if spend reaches 45 or 2 calls are used and the completion check still fails.

outputs: site/index.html (single file, no build step, no local dependencies)
completion_check: File has a viewport meta tag. Title and header contain 'Brew Lab' and 'Indiranagar, Bengaluru'. Menu has 2 or more categories, each item with a name and a ₹ price or a marked placeholder. Hours section reads 8am to 10pm for all 7 days. Location section has a map link or embed and a marked street-address placeholder. Base CSS targets small screens, larger layouts use min-width queries, and there is no horizontal scroll at 360px.

name: Pre-order form with running total
purpose: Visitors cannot pre-order coffee for pickup.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if spend reaches 25 or 2 calls are used and the completion check still fails.

outputs: site/index.html (updated with pre-order form and script)
completion_check: Form has item and quantity inputs, a name field, a pickup time field, a live total in ₹ and a submit button. Changing a quantity updates the total. Visible text says it is a pickup request, not a confirmed or paid order. There is no horizontal scroll at 360px, and the file is still a single file.
